summary: Comprehensive testing of CORS and mobile authentication fixes. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend mobile login flow with localStorage token storage verified working. Bearer token fallback auth confirmed functional - auth persists even after cookies are cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origin_regex=r'.*' correctly replaces allow_origins=['*'] (line 3263). This reflects the actual Origin header instead of returning wildcard.
Login: Correctly cleans old session cookie before creating new one (lines 671-674, 696). This prevents stale cookie issues on mobile.
Login: Deletes expired sessions for user (lines 676-680). Good cleanup mechanism.
Cookie settings: All set_cookie calls use consistent config: secure=True, samesite='none', path='/' (lines 635-642, 697-705, 772-780, 847-855).
Logout: Correctly deletes cookie with matching attributes samesite='none', secure=True (line 880).
get_current_user: Correctly checks cookies first, then falls back to Authorization Bearer header (lines 515-523). This enables mobile auth.
Frontend AuthContext: Stores session_token in localStorage on login (lines 66-68), Google callback (lines 99-101).
Frontend AuthContext: Axios interceptor adds Authorization Bearer header from localStorage (lines 12-18).
Frontend AuthContext: Logout clears localStorage session token (line 124).
Frontend AuthContext: checkAuth clears stale token on 401 error (line 52).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CORS and mobile authentication fixes are verified working. Key points: 1) CORS uses allow_origin_regex to reflect Origin header (avoids Safari blocking). 2) Login cleans old sessions and uses consistent cookie attributes. 3) Bearer token auth works as fallback for mobile browsers that block cookies. 4) localStorage stores session_token for mobile fallback. 5) Axios interceptor automatically adds Bearer header. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_cors_auth_mobile.py
